description: Screen brand name candidates. Give `names` (1 to 30) and optionally `existing` (names to compare against: competitors, your own brands) and `tld` (default com). For each name: letters, syllables, length note, pronunciation or typing hazards (silent letters, consonant stacks, digits, symbols, accents, camel case), spelling-ambiguity patterns with a low, medium or high risk of being misspelled after being heard, a domain-friendly form (availability is NOT checked), and close matches by edit distance, simple sound-key and containment against `existing` and the other candidates. This is a language and usability screen only: it makes no trademark, legal or availability claims and does not check meaning in other languages.

existing.description: Names to compare against (competitors, existing brands)

tld.description: Top-level domain for the domain form, default com

name: naming_check
title: Naming check
